newsitem.title: USA: General Dynamics says earnings jump 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: General Dynamics says earnings jump 20 pct.

text.p: General Dynamics said Wednesday its earnings jumped nearly 20 percent in the latest quarter, and the defence contractor said that with almost no debt, it was looking at strategic opportunities.
It earned $80 million, or $1.28 a share, on sales of $1 billion in the second quarter vs. year-earlier earnings of $67 million, or $1.06 a share, on sales of $930 million.
"We had an excellent quarter, with all of our businesses meeting or exceeding performance goals," said Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Nicholas Chabraja.

"The ongoing consolidation of the defence industry presents additional acquisition opportunities for us," he said. "With $788 million in cash and virtually no debt, we are evaluating strategic opportunities and are prepared to capitalise on our strong position."
General Dynamics' stock was up 31.25 cents at $77.75 in early trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
